purpose: Provide ordinary Windows message-table entries for real Winsock network failures; preserves errors and transport behavior.

10051.text: A socket operation was attempted to an unreachable network.

10060.text: A connection attempt failed because the connected party did not properly respond after a period of time, or established connection failed because connected host has failed to respond.

10065.text: A socket operation was attempted to an unreachable host.
